title: SIPPO — a bubble tea brand with a pixel smile
seo_title: SIPPO Bubble Tea Brand Identity | Muhammad Babar
description: Brand identity case study for SIPPO bubble tea: a pixel wordmark, a mascot with three moods, a lime and pink palette, and packaging, merch and a shopfront.
summary: A playful identity for a bubble tea brand: a pixel wordmark, a mascot with three moods and a loud lime and pink palette, carried from cup sleeves to the shopfront.
cover_alt: SIPPO pixel wordmark in black with the waving pink mascot on an acid lime background

sections.label: The idea
sections.heading: Bubble tea that doesn’t take itself too seriously
sections.body:
SIPPO is a bubble tea brand made for a young, social crowd. The identity leans into fun: a chunky pixel wordmark that reads like a game title, a cheeky mascot, and two loud colours, acid lime and hot pink, set against black and a warm off-white.

The aim was a small system that is simple enough to print on a cup sleeve and strong enough to carry a whole shopfront.

sections.label: At a glance
sections.heading: A small kit that does a lot of work
sections.body: The identity is built from a handful of parts that work together or on their own.

items.title: Wordmark
items.text: A chunky pixel logotype for the name.

items.title: Mascot
items.text: A round pixel character with three moods.

items.title: Colour
items.text: Acid lime and pink, with ink black and off-white.

items.title: Packaging
items.text: Cup sleeves and a two-cup carrier.

items.title: Signage
items.text: A hanging sign and a window graphic.

sections.label: Wordmark
sections.heading: A pixel wordmark that reads like a game title
sections.body: SIPPO is drawn on a square pixel grid, with stepped curves on the S and a slanted O that gives the name a little movement. The heavy strokes stay readable when the logo is small on a cup and still feel crisp when it is metres wide on a window.

images.alt: SIPPO pixel wordmark in black on acid lime

sections.label: Colour
sections.heading: Two loud colours, two quiet ones
sections.body: Lime and pink do the shouting. Ink black carries the wordmark and type, and a warm off-white gives the mascot drawings room to breathe.

sections.label: Typography
sections.heading: One voice to shout, one to whisper
sections.body: The pixel wordmark is the loud voice. Small labels such as BUBBLE TEA are set in a widely spaced monospace that sits under the logo without competing with it.

images.alt: Close-up of pink and lime SIPPO cup sleeves with the wordmark and BUBBLE TEA label

sections.label: Mascot
sections.heading: One character, three moods
sections.body: The SIPPO mascot is a round pixel character drawn on the same grid as the wordmark. It comes in three poses: a wave hello, a wink, and a cool pose with sunglasses and a lime burst. Each one works on its own, so the mascot can sit on a cup, a T-shirt or a window without the logo next to it.

images.alt: The SIPPO pixel mascot in three poses: waving, winking, and wearing sunglasses with a lime starburst

sections.label: Poses
sections.heading: Three poses, drawn on the same grid
sections.body: Each pose is drawn on the same pixel grid as the wordmark, so the character and the logo always look like they belong together.

images.alt: SIPPO mascot in sunglasses with a lime starburst

sections.label: In colour
sections.heading: Pink on lime
sections.body: In colour the mascot turns pink and sits on lime, the brand’s loudest pairing. It is the version used on the window and on merch.

images.alt: Pink SIPPO mascot waving on an acid lime background

sections.label: Packaging
sections.heading: Cups that look like SIPPO from across the room
sections.body: Cup sleeves alternate between lime and pink, so any table of drinks reads as SIPPO at a glance. The carrier puts the wordmark front and centre in pink, with the mascot printed on the lime cups below it.

images.alt: Two SIPPO bubble tea cups with pink and lime sleeves on a café table next to a croissant and sunglasses
A man in a black SIPPO T-shirt carrying a pink SIPPO cup carrier with two lime cups

sections.label: Carrier
sections.heading: A carrier you can spot down the street
sections.body: The two-cup carrier is solid pink with the wordmark front and centre. The lime cups below carry the mascot, so the two brand colours always travel together.

images.alt: Pink SIPPO carrier holding two lime cups printed with the mascot

sections.label: Merch
sections.heading: T-shirts that work without a cup in hand
sections.body: A black tee with the wordmark in white, and a white tee with the black wordmark and the pink mascot. Both use the same pixel lettering as the packaging.

images.alt: Black T-shirt with the SIPPO wordmark in white
White T-shirt with the SIPPO wordmark and pink mascot

sections.label: Signage
sections.heading: From the hanging sign to the window
sections.body: A pink lightbox sign carries the wordmark for passers-by, while the window graphic sets the lime wordmark and the waving mascot at full size.

images.alt: Pink SIPPO hanging sign on a shop wall
Lime SIPPO wordmark and pink mascot on a café window

sections.label: In the world
sections.heading: From T-shirts to the shop window
sections.body: The same few pieces, the wordmark, the mascot and the two colours, carry over to merch and signage: black and white T-shirts, a pink hanging sign, and a lime window graphic big enough to read from across the street.

images.alt: Two friends laughing at a café table in SIPPO T-shirts, one with the pink mascot, with lime and pink SIPPO cups
SIPPO shopfront with a lime pixel wordmark and waving pink mascot on the window

sections.label: How it works
sections.heading: The rules that hold it together

items.title: One grid
items.text: Wordmark and mascot share the same pixel grid.

items.title: Two lead colours
items.text: Lime and pink lead; ink black carries the type.

items.title: Mascot can stand alone
items.text: On cups and merch the character works without the logo.

items.title: Any size
